scope: New calibration context only; do not overwrite earlier experiment or claim matched full native/Android rendering
source: Unchanged isolated-shape calibration manifest, 4 control/shape pairs; no held-out output
native_intervention: Real TabView, UITabBarController, hidden navigation parent and real ScrollView retained; existing title/24 row VStack layout retained but opacity0 and accessibilityHidden; system tab item glyphs/labels remain
feasibility: First 2 input records (circle control and shape), light only; exactly 1 passed test, 2 real sessions; inspect parent classes, bar frame and scroll geometry against prior synthetic-scroll and verify repeat identity before full16 matrix
identity_policy: Each input still launches a fresh process; instance identity required within session only, never across control/shape sessions
clock_policy: Simulator status bar fixed9:41 for each acquisition, with all supported status fields fixed; prior overrides must be empty, restore clear in finally; clocks not inferred from image time
android_reuse: Prior Android isolated-shape pure-background candidate captures may be reused conditionally because product, input and fixture unchanged; bind prior result and candidate source/APK hashes; this does not establish whole-context equality
remaining_limits: Native SF Symbols/tab labels, system material adaptation and native parent remain different from Android
Opacity is an intentional source-context intervention; source code alone cannot prove actual scroll geometry unchanged
No private material property, physical thickness, all-size parity or dynamic completion is inferred
Input foreground absence must be checked in actual calibration screenshots before interpreting optical response
budget: One native build reusing existing DerivedData; 2-session feasibility first, up to16 fresh full-matrix sessions only after passed gate; no Android rebuild or capture, no dynamic capture, no whole-video frame dumps
